## SF/BAY AREA VENUE EXPANSION — user-group shortlist (Z, 2026-11-19)

**Provenance:** Z (Vibe/Mistral), live session, owner ask: "SF user groups that could use me talking for at least 5 minutes. LUGs etc. Let's share my talks, EXPAND our search." Web-verified this session (Meetup/Luma/ chapter sites). Pitches for the top-3 lanes (SF Python 5-min Courier cut, MCP LT SF = MCP Pipes, Bay Area OWASP = Blast Radius) drafted in Mark's Z thread, paste-ready on request; FULL paste-ready abstracts for all five kits already live in canvas **bsidessf-2027-cfp-hard-day**.

### Tier 1 — explicit short slots (5-min doors)
- **SF Python** — 5/15/25-min mix, monthly Presentation Night (2nd Wed), standing CFP form (sfpythonmeetup.com/contribute), explicit lightning + first-time welcome → **Courier 5-min cut**
- **MCP Lightning Talks SF** (Jamsocket series, luma.com/mcp-sf; Anthropic-adjacent crowd; MCP event hub meet.modelcontextprotocol.io) → **MCP Pipes**
- **Noisebridge "Five Minutes of Fame"** (Mission hackerspace, wiki-scheduled) → any bit; Penguin Dharma registers well there

### LUG lane
- **SF-LUG** — 1st Sundays 11-1, SF proper, discussion-format talks (sf-lug.org)
- **BALUG** — 3rd Tuesdays monthly, SF, speakers via wiki/lists (balug.org)
- **BerkeleyLUG** — 2nd+4th Sundays, active thru Dec (berkeleylug.com)
- **SFBayLUG (fka SVLUG)** — HackerDojo Santa Clara, meets WHEN there's a speaker → pitching creates the meeting (meetup.com/sfbaylug)
- **LUGOD** (Davis, 3rd Mon) + **SacLUG** (4th Thu, Hacker Lab) — reach lane
→ Fit: **MS Talk Track A** (SCaLE primary, LUG-perfect), **Much Ado local cut** (45-min LUG version per kit: Zig interlude labelled, Vim/Emacs capstone pending ruling), Bus-B "This Bus Carries Receipts" (LFNW Jan 15 primary)

### Security lane
- **Bay Area OWASP** — monthly, ~3 talks/night, rotating cities (Pleasanton/Mateo/SF); agentic-AI already programming there → **Blast Radius** / **First Catch**
- **AI Security Engineers SF** — Snyk-sponsored, in-person every week or two (via securitycalendar.com/san-francisco-ca.html)
- **ISC2 East Bay** — monthly member meetings; Fall conf theme was "Do I Know You? Identity in the Age of AI" = our lane pre-warmed for next cycle (isc2-eastbay-chapter.org); Dec 10 = year-in-review, Jan 2027 = pitch season
- **Bay Area IAM User Group** — vendor-neutral IAM forum, exact thesis lane; activity quiet → direct ping, not a CFP (meetup.com/BayAreaIAM)
- **DevOops SF** — incident-story meetup, OPEN submission form → Blast Radius reframed as failure-story
- **DevOps Exchange SF** — monthly, 3 short presentations, pitch organizers
- Aggregator worth bookmarking: **securitycalendar.com/san-francisco-ca.html** (verified Oct 2026; ISC2/ISACA/CSA/ISSA + Noisebridge Tuesdays)

### AI/agents lane
- **AICamp SF / SF AI (sfbay-ai, aittg-sfsv)** — weekly SF meetups w/ lightning slots, 50k base → **MCP Pipes**, **Courier** (genre precedent: "Lightning Talk: MCP server for push notifications" on a recent bill)
- **MCP Connect** (Alpic/Stytch/Postman lane, luma.com/f1k2a1lg) — watch for next event CFP

### Hard dates + cautions
- MCP's Official 2nd Birthday Party LT (SF, Nov 20) = tomorrow, too late to pitch but the series recurs
- OWASP Global AppSec SF just ran Nov 5-6; watch 2027 cycle
- KCD SF Bay Area: 2026 CFP was May 12-Jun 14 → put a May 2027 tick on the calendar
- BSidesSF 2027 notifications Dec 20, 2026 — accepted-or-not forks nothing here; same talks may need venue-specific variants per house double-submission/overlap doctrine (BSides double-blind rule = BSides-specific; meetup lanes are not double-blind, but names-gate holds everywhere)
- Buzz-marked: owner rated this search "better than others so far" (receipt in thread)

$0 this pass. Receipt-IDs: none owed (no fires, this is a research/pitch-lane deposit). Seats: additions/amendments welcome; the two Rust-LUG questions in the Much Ado kit (Vim/Emacs capstone, Zig label wording) are still open and become live if a LUG slot is taken.
